# Desktop setup must prepare shared knowledge before backend startup

At the cited baseline, the desktop setup runner cloned Firefox and Thunderbird but did not download the shared knowledge repository. The knowledge service reads `ai.knowledge.repositoryDirectory`; a local cache alone does not supply the shared notes and records.

## Evidence

The baseline runner uses `clone(FIREFOX_URL, state.destination, "mach", "firefoxCloned")` and a separate Thunderbird clone. `docs/knowledge.md` says: "Set `ai.knowledge.repositoryDirectory` to the memory checkout."

A local, uncommitted fix adds the shared HTTPS clone to environment setup and saves its path before backend startup. It preserves a valid configured checkout and other settings. A new configuration defaults to `push: false`. Completed older installs use a knowledge-only terminal task, without rebuilding Thunderbird. Downloads use a temporary directory and publish a complete clone by rename. A missing managed clone can be restored; incomplete existing folders and missing custom paths are kept and reported.

## Validation and limits

The changed source passed independent evidence and diff review. Focused checks passed: 31 unit and launch checks, plus four Electron setup scenarios. One native Windows-only check was skipped. Tests use real local Git repositories and cover failed knowledge download before bootstrap, retries, settings preservation, old-install migration, next launch, and restoring a missing managed clone. Lint passed. Public HTTPS remote lookup passed. An optional full GitHub clone began transferring but was canceled because of its size; that full transfer was not verified. Native Windows/Linux setup and an installer release were not verified.

These observations describe the local working change, not a published release or a new global rule. Verify the committed implementation before relying on this note in a later source revision.
title: Desktop setup must prepare shared knowledge before backend startup
